c74object.name: touch.dialitin
c74object.description: A modern circular rotary dial featuring a unified 4-way rotary engine (270 arc, 360 top-clamped, 360 bottom-clamped, and 360 continuous endless wrap), touch stepping and proximity inertia easing, bumper-clamped boundary physics, single-line or filled ribbon styles with extended needle tips, two-pass decoupled typography, and an integrated 50/50 Attrui parameter inspector with bound tickers, spectrum color pickers, and wireless theme bus synchronization.

inlet.digest: Value input, bang, or configuration messages
inlet.description: Accepts numeric inputs to update the dial position, bang to trigger output, or configuration and theme messages to update attributes dynamically.

outlet.description: Outputs the scaled floating-point value mapped linearly between min_val and max_val.

method.name: bang
method.description: Outputs the current scaled value through the outlet.

method.name: float
method.description: Sets the dial position according to the scaled range (min_val to max_val) and outputs the resulting value.

method.name: int
method.description: Converted to a float to set the dial position, triggering output.

method.name: set
method.description: Sets the internal dial position without producing an output message.

method.name: popup
method.description: Opens, closes, or toggles the floating parameter inspector window. An optional argument of 1 or 0 explicitly opens or closes the window.

method.name: update
method.digest: Refresh theme from bus or persistent store
method.description: Forces the component to reload and re-render its visual styling from the global wireless theme bus or persistent dictionary store. Also accepts aliases theme_update and refresh_theme.

attribute.name: style
attribute.description:
Selects between two chassis aesthetics:
0 = Ribbon (donut arc track with active fill or single-line indicator)
1 = Rail (circular guide wire with scalable needle and perimeter orb knob)

attribute.name: ribbon_fill
attribute.description:
Determines active value display when Ribbon style is selected:
0 = Single Line (draws an extended radial indicator line without filling the track)
1 = Arc Fill (fills the preceding track arc solidly up to the current value)

attribute.name: border_mode
attribute.description:
Controls the sweep geometry of the outer perimeter rim:
0 = Match Arc (border opens up to match the arc gap when < 360°)
1 = Full Circle (border always forms a complete 360° closed circle)

attribute.name: rotary_mode
attribute.description:
Configures angular travel and boundary clamping:
0 = 270 (standard 270° horseshoe arc with bottom gap)
1 = 360 Top (full 360° circle clamped with zero and stop tick at 12:00)
2 = 360 Bottom (full 360° circle clamped with zero and stop tick at 6:00)
3 = 360 Continuous (full 360° circle with endless continuous wrapping)

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description:
Determines touch and drag handling physics:
0 = Touch (discrete stepping on tap, hold-repeat, inertia easing on drag)
1 = Mouse (direct absolute jump to cursor position)

attribute.name: mouse_mode
attribute.description:
Axis mapping for mouse and trackpad drags:
0 = Vertical (linear up/down drag, clamped)
1 = Horizontal (linear left/right drag, clamped)
2 = Radial (circular angular tracking around the dial center)

attribute.name: min_val
attribute.description: Sets the lower boundary of the dial output range (default: 0.0). When set negative with a positive max_val, the dial automatically configures bipolar center-zero behavior with 0 resting at 12:00.

attribute.name: max_val
attribute.description: Sets the upper boundary of the dial output range (default: 1.0).

attribute.name: step_amount
attribute.description: The numeric increment or decrement applied per discrete tap or hold-step interval in Touch mode.

attribute.name: step_speed_ms
attribute.description: The interval in milliseconds between repeated discrete step increments when holding down on the track in Touch mode.

attribute.name: curve_exponent
attribute.description: Exponential factor governing distance-dependent proximity drag easing in Touch mode.

attribute.name: slider_speed
attribute.description: Multiplier controlling rotary travel speed during dragging and trackpad wheel rotation.

attribute.name: label_text
attribute.description: Descriptive text prefix displayed centered above the numerical value.

attribute.name: label_mode
attribute.description:
Controls text abbreviation and visibility:
0 = Full (full string rendered)
1 = No Vowels (removes inner vowels while preserving first letters)
2 = Caps Only (extracts capital letters and digits)
3 = First Letter (extracts the first letter of each word)
4 = No Text (suppresses label text completely)

attribute.name: case_mode
attribute.description:
Text capitalization normalization:
0 = First Cap (Title Case)
1 = All Cap (Uppercase)
2 = All Small (Lowercase)

attribute.name: font_name
attribute.description: Name of the font family used to render the value and label.

attribute.name: font_size
attribute.description: Point size of the rendered label and value text (clamped $\ge 6$).

attribute.name: font_style
attribute.description:
Font posture and weight:
0 = Regular
1 = Bold
2 = Italic
3 = Bold Italic

attribute.name: track_breadth
attribute.description: Stroke width of the circular guide track rail.

attribute.name: handle_size
attribute.description: Radius in pixels of the sliding circular orb knob in Rail mode.

attribute.name: needle_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke line width of the extended needle line indicator.

attribute.name: border_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke line width of the outer dial chassis border rim.

attribute.name: dial_margin
attribute.description: Inset margin in pixels between the outer object bounding box and the dial circular face.

attribute.name: bg_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the inner circular dial face plate.

attribute.name: border_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the outer perimeter rim and boundary stop tick mark.

attribute.name: track_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the background inactive guide track.

attribute.name: handle_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the active arc fill, needle indicator line, and orb knob.

attribute.name: text_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the rendered numerical value text.

attribute.name: mode_color
attribute.description: RGBA color dedicated to the label prefix text, decoupled from the value text color.

attribute.name: popup_dot_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the top-right launcher dot used to open the parameter inspector.

attribute.name: pop_bgcolor
attribute.description: RGBA background color of the floating parameter inspector window.

attribute.name: attr_bg_color
attribute.description: RGBA background fill color for individual 50/50 attribute rows.

attribute.name: attr_border_color
attribute.description: RGBA outline color for attribute row containers and value boxes.

attribute.name: attr_slider_color
attribute.description: RGBA active fill color for sliders inside the 50/50 attribute inspector.

attribute.name: attr_text_color
attribute.description: RGBA text color for attribute names and value labels inside the inspector.

attribute.name: allow_popup
attribute.description: Enables or disables the top-right pop-up dot launcher and right-click access to the inspector window.

attribute.name: show_settings_attrs
attribute.description: Master toggle to show or hide the 50/50 attribute list inside the pop-up inspector window.

attribute.name: popup_mini_size
attribute.description: Two floating-point values representing width and height of the collapsed mini-mode preview window.

attribute.name: mask_performance
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of Operating Style, Ribbon Fill, Border Sweep, Rotary Mode, Touch/Mouse Mode, Drag Axis, and Range Bounds in the inspector.

attribute.name: mask_labels
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Label Style, Case Style, and Font Styling section in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_geometry
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of Track Breadth, Handle Size, Needle Thickness, Border Thickness, Dial Margin, and Font Size in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_colors
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Face/BG, Border Rim, Track Rail, Needle/Fill, and Decoupled Text Colors section in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_popup_colors
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the 5-color Inspector Theme Palette section in the pop-up inspector.
